scoring_justification: Full recompute of heat capacity and entropy from analytic formulas is feasible and provides strong verification.

outputs.description: Temperature-dependent heat capacity and entropy for the multiple-transition parameter set. The checker will recompute these values at hidden temperature points and compare with the submitted CSV within a relative tolerance.
Heat capacity curve for the isotropic singly decorated lattice. The checker will recompute at hidden temperature points and compare.
Critical temperature of the isotropic decorated lattice. A single floating-point number; the checker will compare it to the exact theoretical value within an absolute tolerance.

output_contract.notes: All formulas are fully described in the method-level instruction (no paper equation numbers). The checker uses hidden gold values derived from the analytic expressions and the theoretical Tc.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for comparison are recomputed in checker using the exact analytic expressions from the paper, evaluated at hidden temperature points.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper equations for the general decorated square lattice (Eqs. 6-9) and the isotropic case (Eq. 12), and the exact theoretical critical temperature.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Numerical integration with scipy.integrate.nquad (general case) and direct evaluation of elliptic integrals (isotropic case); Tc from analytical formula.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The gold values are derived from the same analytic expressions as the paper's results, ensuring a correct reproduction can match them within tolerance.
